subject: treasureHoard
pitch:
Category: Prop group.
Subject: treasure hoard: coins, gems, chest, crown, goblets.
Style: League of Legends.
reasoning:
Looking at the renders, I'm spotting some problems: the hex base seems a bit skewed but acceptable, while the rocks are way oversized icosahedra forming giant purple blobs that block the view of the hoard in the foreground.

The lid pose looks fine open, though one side reads darker than expected but that's probably just the liner material. The bigger issue is the coin piles burying the chest entirely—the front mound is too tall and positioned where it hides the chest front, so I need to shrink its height and shift it forward slightly. The spilled goblet also looks a bit too bulky in the scene.

The rune circle is mostly hidden under the hoard; I should consider adding a glowing hex trim around the base edge instead so it's still visible. One of the floating sparkle rings near the front-right corner looks like it's awkwardly overhanging the edge of the base rather than sitting naturally on it, so I want to pull it inward closer to the mound.

Checking the hex geometry, the edge at that position actually cuts off at z=0.80, which means the ring at (0.9, 0.9) is floating off the base entirely. I need to reposition it to somewhere like (0.6, 0.8) or (-0.3, 0.98), which fall safely inside the hex boundary.

The base itself also feels too thin and flat — I'm thinking a thicker plinth with stepped tiers and gold corner studs would give it more weight and presence as a staging platform.

Updating base outline coordinates and inlay shape...

I'm skipping the gold corner studs idea since the orientation is unclear, and instead scaling down the rock placements, positioning smaller rocks along the back and sides with varied sizes.

But checking the hex boundary, several rocks and crystal clusters sit right on or past the edge, so I need to nudge their positions inward to avoid overhanging, while watching for collisions with the ingot placement.

Checking back-edge rocks and crystal clusters for edge pokes, I'm nudging a few positions inward—moving the x=0.5 back rock to z=-0.9, repositioning the crystal clusters near (0.78,-0.84) and (-0.72,-0.9) slightly to avoid clipping the platform boundary.

I'm also verifying the gem piles near (0.78,0.62) and (0.78,-0.38) stay within the elliptical edge, then turning to the chest's front pile and checking gem/crown placement doesn't block visibility of the chest.

I'm checking that hero coins and crystal clusters sit correctly relative to the height function, confirming the goblet and gold piles stay visible, and considering adding a subtle warm glow light beneath the lid for atmosphere.

I also need to fix the toppled goblet, which is sinking into the floor since its radius pushes it below floor level — raising its y-position should fix that. And the chest-fill pile's starting height needs to be recalculated relative to the floor so it sits properly inside the rim instead of using the old hardcoded value.

Replacing the whole array block exactly as-is to avoid partial edit errors.
